_meta.description: SOF's ideal daily Dawnium spend in priority order (spend from the top; cut optional lines first when short). Line totals from the 'Dawnium Daily Spend' infographic: 250 + 1080 + 270 + 400 = 2000. Per-unit prices are not in the SOF guides; unit_costs are filled from other sources where known (null = unknown). Extra Dawnium beyond this: relic gacha early in a season, more Material Realm tools toward mid season (S-02 p.19).

purchases.what: Buy extra Material Realm tools in the 4/2/4/4 split
purchases.notes: Alternative splits named by the guides: 4444 (most popular), 6446 (if desperate for power, S-02 p.18). Their Dawnium cost is not given. Early season skew toward Sand, mid season toward Ore.
First donation free, then 20 and 50 [R-103]; the official handbook allows up to 5 a day and recommends paying 70 for two more [S-87].
Named by S-01 p.14 as one of the first purchases to cut when short on Dawnium. Not the Gold Pickaxe: probably a 24-hour guild gathering boost (unconfirmed; see currencies.json guild_gold_tool).
